symptom: Field test on ako/mxcli#2101: with `run --local --watch --test-endpoint`, `run status` said "change pending" for the whole session (5+ minutes) and nothing was ever built; `git status` showed the project settings modified, and a container recycle left AfterStartupMicroflow = MxTest.RegisterEndpoint in the project, where it could be committed.
cause: Two. The boot build scaffolds themesource/mxtest/ for the endpoint's module; the watcher excludes a build's own scaffold (sourceMTimeExcept, ako/mxcli#2033) but `run status` and `run wait` compared docker.SourceMTime, the unfiltered signal, with the boot's Last.Source, so they saw a change the watcher rightly never built (and `run wait` waited into its timeout). And only `run stop` and the next --test-endpoint run called RestoreAbandonedEndpoint, so a run killed with its container left the after-startup swap in place with nothing looking at it.
file: cmd/mxcli/docker/runstate.go (RunState.Scaffold, RunStateRecorder.Scaffold, SourceMTimeOf), cmd/mxcli/docker/runlocal.go (record the scaffold in the state), cmd/mxcli/cmd_run_lifecycle.go (status and wait use SourceMTimeOf), cmd/mxcli/testrunner/host_restore.go (LeftoverEndpointWarning), cmd/mxcli/cmd_run.go and cmd_check.go (restore and warn)
insight: A fix to a change signal has to reach every reader of that signal, not only the loop that reported the bug: #2033 fixed the watcher and left `run status`/`run wait`, which read the same question from the state file, on the old answer. Persist the filter with the state, so a reader cannot compute a different signal. The 'settings modified in git' symptom was a red herring for the pending change; the measurement that settled it was listing the files newer than Last.Source (all themesource/mxtest/). The test fails with SourceMTimeOf reduced to the unfiltered signal; on the spike app run status showed no pending change, run wait returned at once, an edit to the scaffolded folder still built, and a SIGKILLed hosted run was warned about by check -p and removed by the next plain run.
